subject: Velocity MAP: pricing slate, milestone commits & renewal pathway
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@vectorpay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Velocity MAP draft and proposed accelerator credit

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass "Velocity MAP" I put together for VectorPay (see VectorPay_Velocity_MAP_v3.pdf). The objective is to lock the evaluation milestones, commit thresholds, and the renewal uplift calculation so we can shorten the path to production while protecting both sides on quality and spend.

Highlights:  
- 30-day evaluation with 50k token credit to validate latency and integration
- Milestone A (end of eval): API KPIs and 10-seat pilot
- Milestone B (month 3): commit to reserved capacity ($50k/mo target) with ramp discounts
- Renewal uplift: commit credit applied to year-2 baseline if ramp targets met

We can offer a one-time "accelerator credit" (10% of first 6 months) if VectorPay signs the MAP + SOW by Nov 30 and hits Milestone B within 90 days. If procurement needs a pricing slate with staged discounts I can push a clean version over — looping Jordan and Karthik for pricing/legal input.

Attaching: VectorPay_Velocity_MAP_v3.pdf (draft)

Next step: Can we lock a 45-minute call this week to align on the Milestone B metric set and procurement must-haves?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rojas <elena@vectorpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Nguyen <marcus@vectorpay.com>, VectorPay Procurement <procurement@vectorpay.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Velocity MAP draft and proposed accelerator credit

Tessa —

Thanks for the draft. VectorPay likes the approach; a few questions from product and procurement before we lock dates:

1) Can you make the renewal uplift formula explicit? We need the exact conversion of pilot credits to year-2 baseline (example math).
2) Milestone metrics: please include API p50/p95 latencies and a token cap per month for the pilot — procurement needs these to understand overage exposure.
3) Accelerator credit: procurement will want clarity on what converts to the credit (committed spend vs consumed spend).
4) Doc timeline: we can get an internal decision by Nov 30 only if the SOW and pricing are finalized this week.

Looping Marcus and procurement on questions 2 and 3. Marcus — can you flag any mandatory PO/insurance/KYC items we need in the SOW?

- Elena
Director, Product
VectorPay
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@vectorpay.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Velocity MAP draft and proposed accelerator credit

Elena —

Appreciate the detailed notes. Attaching a clean Pricing_Slate_v2.xlsx that maps staged discounts to committed thresholds and shows how the accelerator credit would be applied at renewal. Key points from our side:  

- Renewal uplift math: Pilot credits are treated as prepaid committed dollars. Example: $50k pilot credit applied -> year-2 baseline reduced by $30k if Milestone B (90-day ramp target) is met; otherwise credit is consumed in first-year billing. Exact formula in the spreadsheet.
- Milestone metrics: propose p50 < 60ms, p95 < 250ms for API calls at pilot quotas (we'll include token caps).
- Pricing staircase: 5% discount at $50k/mo commit, 10% at $100k/mo, 15% at $200k/mo (these stack with reserved capacity pricing).
- Accelerator credit: 10% of the first 6 months committed spend converted to a renewal credit if signed by Nov 30 and Milestone B is met within 90 days.

We can be flexible on structure — would trade deeper discounts for a longer committed term if VectorPay prefers predictability. Karthik, anything to add from legal/contracting side?

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Strategy Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Nguyen <marcus@vectorpay.com>
To: VectorPay Procurement <procurement@vectorpay.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Velocity MAP draft and proposed accelerator credit

- Need explicit cancellation/termination language if KPIs aren't met during pilot.
- PO timing: we prefer net-45 on the pilot convertible credit.
- Insurance and SOC2 evidence required prior to production cutover.

I will compile a short redline doc and return by Monday.

-Marcus

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0500
Subject: SOW draft + pilot conversion credit clarification

Marcus / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the SOW_VectorPay_draft.docx that reflects the cancellation language and SOC2 evidence timeline. A couple clarifications on the pilot conversion idea so procurement has the exact mechanics:  

- Pilot is a $50k reserved capacity credit (applied to hosted usage). If Milestone B (ramp to 50k tokens/day sustained for a 14-day window) is met within 90 days, $30k of that pilot converts to a year-2 baseline credit (applied as a dollar reduction to committed baseline).
- Payment terms: pilot invoiced up-front as a deposit and applied against the first invoice; converted credit triggers on documented KPI acceptance form. We can accept Net-45 for the pilot deposit.
- Overages: billed monthly at on-demand rates; we recommend enabling auto-throttle to protect against surprise overages.

If procurement can confirm PO timing and any insurance clauses, we can incorporate those redlines into the final SOW and circulate for signature.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: SOW_VectorPay_draft.docx)
From: Elena Rojas <elena@vectorpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Nguyen <marcus@vectorpay.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOW draft + pilot conversion credit clarification

Tessa / Jordan —

This reads well. A few final asks before we can take to our CFO:  

1) Please add a short table in the MAP that lists the exact KPI acceptance tests (p50/p95 latency, token/day, error rate threshold) and who signs off (Product & Infra).
2) For audit purposes we need 13-month log retention for API access logs as an add-on line item — can you price that separately?
3) Renewal uplift: we accept the conversion math but ask that any conversion credit be capped to 50% of the pilot deposit to avoid year-2 baseline cliffs.

If you can send an updated MAP + pricing (including a separate line for log retention) I will aim to get procurement and finance sign-off the week of Nov 23. Can we book a 30-min call tomorrow to align on the KPI table?

-Elena
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@vectorpay.com>, Marcus Nguyen <marcus@vectorpay.com>, VectorPay Procurement <procurement@vectorpay.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Velocity MAP — agreed next steps and DocuSign path for accelerator

Team —

Thanks for the productive exchange. Capture / next steps below so we have a single source of truth:  

1) MAP: Tessa to incorporate explicit KPI table (p50/p95 latency, error rate < 0.5%, token/day caps). Updated MAP will include sign-off owners (Product + Infra).
2) Pilot: $50k reserved capacity deposit; conversion mechanic clarified (max conversion $30k; Elena requested cap at 50% of deposit — we will set conversion cap to $25k per Elena's ask).
3) Pricing staircase: 5% @ $50k/mo, 10% @ $100k/mo, 15% @ $200k/mo. Accelerator credit: 10% of first 6 months converted to renewal credit if signed by Nov 30 and Milestone B achieved within 90 days.
4) Audit & retention: pricing addendum for 13-month log retention to be quoted as an add-on in the final pricing spreadsheet.
5) Legal/procurement: Redwood to accept Net-45 for pilot deposit; final SOW will include SOC2 evidence timeline.
6) Signing window: we will circulate final MAP + SOW + HubSpot deal update and DocuSign link; signature by Nov 30 required to trigger accelerator credit.

Action owners: Tessa (map + docs, circulate by EOD Mon), Jordan (final pricing spreadsheet), Karthik (contract redlines), VectorPay procurement (confirm PO timing).

Circulating HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/elim/abcd-vecpay-sign

Please reply if any of the bullets look off. Otherwise I'll send the final package Monday.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
